note: נפתח records the consonantal stem of the gentilic. Its derivation is unknown.
summary: נַפְתֻּחִים names a people descended from Mizraim. Both genealogies list them immediately after the Lehabim.

senses.definition: A people counted among the descendants of Mizraim.

evidence.note: וְאֶת נַפְתֻּחִים introduces the fourth people whom Mizraim is said to have fathered.
The parallel genealogy names the Naphtuhim in the same position after the Lehabim.
